hints.title: Canonical Palindrome Search
hints.text: Every good integer has digits that can be rearranged into a palindrome divisible by k. We only need to enumerate palindromes directly by iterating their first half.

hints.title: Unique Digit Multiset Deduplication
hints.text: Whenever a palindrome is divisible by k, register its sorted digit frequency multiset to prevent duplicate counting across permutations.

hints.title: Combinatorial Permutation Counting
hints.text: For each valid multiset, compute multinomial permutations using factorials while subtracting invalid configurations starting with zero.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Enumerate first half of palindromes up to 10^5 followed by multinomial formulas.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(10^(n/2)) hash set stores valid digit multisets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generates base palindromes and applies multinomial coefficient combinatorics.
